absent: Locking, preemption and lifetime rules for trace registration, perf buffers and writeback objects beyond the preemption guard and fault allowance markers.
Transition ordering and state update effects for netfs folio, queue, donation and contiguous collection vocabularies.
Numeric values for power event codes, signal sentinels and codes, folio predicates, page shift and device and memory type enumerations.
Allocator behavior, failure modes and submission guarantees for perf buffers and program array validation.
Full payload layouts, field offsets and display formats for writeback, Xen, XDP, power and signal events.
Build configuration conditions selecting the enabled versus fallback cgroup attribution variant.

findings.text: The pagemap flag word assigns decimal weight one to PAGEMAP_MAPPED and decimal weight two to PAGEMAP_ANONYMOUS and decimal weight four to PAGEMAP_FILE and decimal weight eight to PAGEMAP_SWAPCACHE and decimal weight sixteen to PAGEMAP_SWAPBACKED and decimal weight thirty two to PAGEMAP_MAPPEDDISK and decimal weight sixty four to PAGEMAP_BUFFERS.

Reclaim writeback tracing uses RECLAIM_WB_ANON for anonymous with decimal one and RECLAIM_WB_FILE for file with decimal two and RECLAIM_WB_SYNC for synchronous with decimal four and RECLAIM_WB_ASYNC for asynchronous with decimal eight and RECLAIM_WB_MIXED for mixed with decimal sixteen, while RECLAIM_WB_LRU combines anonymous and file, with synchronous documented as unused because reclaim stays asynchronous.

Scanning throttle flags are single bits formed by shifting one by VMSCAN_THROTTLE_WRITEBACK and VMSCAN_THROTTLE_ISOLATED and VMSCAN_THROTTLE_NOPROGRESS and VMSCAN_THROTTLE_CONGESTED, rendered by name with a none fallback when empty.

Signal tracing enumerates five ordered outcomes where TRACE_SIGNAL_DELIVERED appears first and TRACE_SIGNAL_IGNORED appears second and TRACE_SIGNAL_ALREADY_PENDING appears third and TRACE_SIGNAL_OVERFLOW_FAIL appears fourth and TRACE_SIGNAL_LOSE_INFO appears fifth.
Power tracing reserves decimal negative one for PWR_EVENT_EXIT as the exit direction marker, protected by a double definition avoidance marker.

Hopeless clearing distinguishes KSWAPD_CLEAR_HOPELESS_KSWAPD rendered as KSWAPD and KSWAPD_CLEAR_HOPELESS_DIRECT rendered as DIRECT and KSWAPD_CLEAR_HOPELESS_PCP rendered as PCP and KSWAPD_CLEAR_HOPELESS_OTHER rendered as OTHER, while the reclaim flag helper chooses file versus anonymous from a boolean and always includes asynchronous.
Page count to kilobyte conversion in both helpers shifts left by page shift minus ten, turning a base page count into kilobytes without division.
Device map tracing uses a small wrapper holding a single network device pointer in field dev to carry the destination across redirect observations.

Trace record layout helpers distinguish fixed scalar fields and fixed arrays from dynamic arrays represented only by a thirty two bit offset, with three string forms all lowered to dynamic character arrays of unspecified length and with filter type and embedded structure variants preserving the same storage.

Network filesystem trace enumerations reuse one macro list in three passes where the first pass creates byte sized enumeration members and the second pass registers each member for tracing and the third pass builds identifier to label pairs, covering read and write and request and reference and folio and contiguity and donation and queue families.

Lookaside and writeback reason vocabularies share a two pass pattern where the first pass registers each symbolic reason for tracing and the second pass emits identifier to description pairs, keeping registration and presentation derived from one list.

Packet action and memory type vocabularies are defined by a higher order list macro applied once to a registration function and once to a symbol table function, with a negative one terminator marking the end of each table.

Enumeration and size registration creates linked objects where an init resident map stores the tracing system name plus the symbolic spelling plus the numeric value and a second pointer placed in a dedicated evaluation section refers to that map.

Each routed header declares its own grouping label such as nmi for interrupts and notifier for notifications and objagg for aggregation and oom for memory pressure and page_isolation for isolation and page_pool for pools and page_ref for references and pagemap for mapping and percpu for per cpu and power for power and printk for messages and readahead for prefetch and rseq for sequences and rwmmio for mapped input output and signal for signals and swiotlb for bounce buffers and raw_syscalls for calls and task for tasks and thp for huge pages and timestamp for time and tlb for lookaside and vmalloc for allocation and vmscan for reclaim and wbt for throttling and workqueue for queues and writeback for writeback and xdp for packet path and xen for virtualization. The system call header additionally fixes its include file name as syscalls.
Routed headers each define a single unique preprocessing marker that prevents repeated inclusion, with spelling derived from the subsystem name.

Performance observation provides a per event worker plus a thin wrapper that guards against preemption without tracing and then invokes the worker, with a system call variant that additionally permits faults before guarding, plus helpers to override sample count and attributed task. Template helpers validate probe compatibility and forward print variants to the same validation.

The performance worker contracts that record storage is eight byte aligned and sized from dynamic offsets plus fixed header, that absence of local clients plus absence of valid programs plus absence of an explicit task permits an early return without allocation, and that successful allocation always captures caller registers before copying caller fields and submitting through the combined program path.
If record allocation fails the observation is silently dropped with no error signal, so callers cannot distinguish congestion or memory pressure from absence of activity.

Signal capture must distinguish two sentinel pointers meaning no information and privileged kernel origin from genuine pointers, because only genuine pointers may be dereferenced for error and code fields, with sentinels mapping to zero error plus user or kernel origin respectively.

The pagemap flag composer reports anonymous versus file as mutually exclusive alternatives and independently adds mapped and swap cache and swap backed and mapped to disk and buffer private bits according to separate folio predicates.
Reclaim and throttle and inode state printers render each set bit by symbolic name joined with a separator and substitute a single none label when no bits are set, keeping empty masks observable.

Writeback cgroup attribution has two build variants where the enabled variant resolves the owning cgroup number from the writeback structure and the disabled variant always reports one, while the control variant delegates to the writeback variant when a writeback object is present and otherwise reports one.

Packet redirect shims provide four conveniences where plain and error forms supply absent destination and default map parameters while map forms forward caller supplied destination plus map type plus identifier plus index, with error forms additionally forwarding the failure code.

Xen memory observations bind a template for entry protection changes taking an address space plus address plus entry pointer plus entry value and a template for directory events taking an address space plus directory pointer.

Writeback observations provide three constructors where the work constructor binds a writeback object plus a work item and the plain constructor binds only a writeback object and the control constructor binds a control object plus a backing device.

Power tracing maps suspend and resume and freeze and quiesce and hibernate and thaw and restore and recover and poweroff verbs to printable names, wraps event names as trace strings, and offers grow versus shrink wrappers that forward new and old polling intervals with a direction flag.

Network filesystem folio handling exposes a vocabulary covering copy scheduling and completion and gap filling and front middle tail invalidation and multiple kill reasons and write fault handling and lock and writeback absence checks and reference release and read progress and dirtying and store variants and write through variants, complemented by small vocabularies for contiguous collection with jump and unlock, for donation direction with deferral, and for queue allocation clearing deletion spacing and progress.
Timestamp tracing exposes a single queried flag rendered as Q when I_CTIME_QUERIED is present.

Lookaside reasons distinguish task switch flushes from local and remote shootdowns including memory context scope and inter processor signalling plus a wrong processor case, while writeback reasons distinguish background and reclaim and synchronous and periodic and free space and thread creation and cross group flush and uncached writes.
